chunks: The virtuous Shaykh and jurist, Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Mūsā ibn Bābawayh al-Qummī, the author of this book, may the mercy of Allah be upon him, said: Indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, says:
And We sent down from the sky pure water.
And He, Mighty and Majestic, says:
And We sent down from the sky water in due measure, then We lodged it in the earth, and indeed We are surely able to take it away.
And He, Mighty and Majestic, says:
And He sends down upon you water from the sky to purify you with it.
So the origin of all water is from the sky, and all of it is purifying; the water of the sea is purifying, and the water of the well is purifying.

key_terms.السَّمَاءِ: the sky, from which Allah sends down water
key_terms.الْبَحْرِ: the sea; its water is explicitly stated to be purifying
key_terms.الْبِئْرِ: the well; its water is explicitly stated to be purifying
key_terms.بِقَدَرٍ: in due measure; with divine determination and proportion
key_terms.طَهُورًا: purifying; that which is itself pure and purifies other things
key_terms.لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ: to purify you; indicating water’s role in purification
key_terms.مَاءً: water, the substance discussed as the basis of ritual purification

ai.seo_question: What is the proof that sea water and well water are purifying in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This passage cites Qur'anic verses to establish that water originates by Allah’s sending from the sky and is described as purifying. On that basis, it states a legal ruling in ritual purity: all water is tahir and purifying, including sea water and well water.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
The virtuous scholar, jurist Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Hussain ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi, the author of this book, may God have mercy on him, said:
"Indeed, Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, says:
'And We sent down from the sky pure water' (Surah Al Furqan 25:48).
And He, Mighty and Majestic, says:
'And We sent down from the sky water in due measure, and We settled it in the earth, and indeed We are able to take it away' (Surah Al Mu'minun 23:18).
And He, Mighty and Majestic, says:
'And He sent down upon you water from the sky to purify you with it' (Surah Al-Anfal 8:11).
Therefore, all water originates from the sky, and all of it is purifying. Sea water is pure, and well water is pure."
